model: Altivar Machine ATV340 (embedded Modbus serial / Modbus TCP)
applies_to: ATV340 drives on the built-in Modbus serial port; Ethernet versions (ATV340...N4E) expose the same addresses on embedded Modbus TCP. Per Communication Parameters file NVE61728 V4.6.
summary: Schneider Electric's high-performance machine drive with Modbus RTU on the built-in serial port, plus embedded Ethernet on the N4E versions. Each parameter has a fixed decimal logical address sent as the holding-register address. This map covers the CiA402 command and status words, frequency and speed references, the main monitors, energy counters, fault and warning codes, I/O states and the Modbus and channel settings needed for network control.

addressing.note: The parameter file gives each logical address in hex and decimal (16#0C81 = 3201); the decimal value goes into the request unchanged. The Modbus serial manual's example reads W3102-W3105 by sending start address 0C1E hex (= 3102) and writes W9001 at 2329 hex, so there is no 40001 offset and no minus 1.

source.title: ATV340 - Communication Parameters (Excel)
source.pages: Sheet 'Parameters' (code, logic address, access, type, unit, factory, range), sheet 'Enumerations' (HMIS, LFT, ALR, PSA, CDX, TBR, FOR, ECFG, INR, STT, IPM), sheet 'Registers' (CMI, ETI, CRC, CCC, IL1R, OL1R bits). Modbus manual NVE61654 (06/2016): pp. 31-33 Add/tbr/tFO/ttO, pp. 45-47 CMD and ETA bits and state table, p. 71 M1EC/M1CT.

notes: Second source: Altivar Machine ATV340 Modbus Serial Line Manual NVE61654 (06/2016), https://download.schneider-electric.com/files?p_Doc_Ref=NVE61654 - addressing examples, function codes, settings, the CiA402 sequence and the CMD/ETA bit layout (the parameter file does not break these two words out bit by bit).

Every register in this map is a single 16-bit word. 32-bit values (RTH motor run time 3244, PTH power-on time 3246, both UINT32 in seconds) are left out because neither document states their word order.
LFR (8502) and RFR (3202) are 0.1 Hz only while CMI bit 9 = 0; with bit 9 = 1 they become a signed value where 32767 = tFr. The parameter file states this in the CMI bit 9 description.
LCR (3204) is left unscaled: the parameter file says 'refer to programming manual' and the programming manual (NVE61643) only says the unit follows the drive rating.
ACC/DEC (9001/9002) are raw values; their resolution follows INR (9020): 0 = 0.01 s, 1 = 0.1 s (factory), 2 = 1 s.
Energy is split into 0-999 registers per decade: motor energy = OC4 TWh + OC3 GWh + OC2 MWh + OC1 kWh + OC0 Wh; input energy likewise with IC0-IC4.
Value lists for HMIS, LFT/DP0-DP3, LALR, FR1 (PSA list), CD1, TBR and the stop/fault reactions are copied from the Enumerations sheet.
Registers shown as RW that the file lists as R/WS can only be written while the drive is not running.
Left out: NCR, ITH, AI physical values, PID feedback/reference and SPD because their unit is 'refer to programming manual'; option-card, safety and function-block parameters.
ETHL, IM00 and TTOB only apply to the Ethernet versions (ATV340...N4E). Neither source states the Modbus TCP port, so tcp_port is left null.

Ethernet manual NVE61653 (12/2018, https://download.schneider-electric.com/files?p_Doc_Ref=NVE61653): on Modbus TCP, Unit ID 0 or 248 reaches the drive parameters at the same logical addresses; Unit ID 255 is the I/O scanner.

integration.summary: Set Add (6001) to 1-247 and power-cycle, keep CHCF = SIM and set FR1 to Modbus (164), then write CMD (8501) = 0006h followed by 000Fh with a non-zero LFR (8502, 0.1 Hz) or LFRD (8602, rpm). Poll ETA (3201), RFR (3202), HMIS (3240) and LFT (7121).
integration.enable: Set [Modbus Address] Add (logical 6001) to 1-247; the factory value 0 (OFF) means the drive does not answer. Speed and format default to 19200 baud, 8-E-1 (tbr 6003, tFO 6004). Communication changes take effect after a power cycle. For combined CiA402 control keep [Control Mode] CHCF = [Not separ.] SIM and set [Ref Freq 1 Config] FR1 = Modbus (164); for separate mode use CHCF = SEP with Cd1 = Modbus.
integration.watchdog: [ModbusTimeout] ttO (6005), 0.1-30 s, factory 10 s. If no valid Modbus frame arrives within ttO on a monitored channel, the drive raises [Modbus Com Interruption] SLF1 and reacts per SLL (7010): factory freewheel stop, or ignore, configured stop, fallback speed LFF (7080), speed maintained, ramp stop, fast stop or DC injection.
quirks: Addresses are decimal logical numbers sent as-is (3201 = 0x0C81); do not subtract 1 or add 40001.
CiA402 sequence: 0006h (shutdown) -> Ready to switch on, then 000Fh (enable operation) to run; 0007h disables operation, 0000h disables voltage, 0002h quick stop, 0080h rising edge resets a fault.
Mask ETA with 006Fh to read the state: 0040h switch on disabled, 0021h ready to switch on, 0023h switched on, 0027h operation enabled, 0007h quick stop active, 0008h/0028h fault.
CMD bit 11 is reverse direction by default ([Reverse Assign] rrS = C111); bits 12-15 can be assigned to functions (C112-C115).
setup: Set Add, tbr and tFO in the [Communication] COM- / [Modbus SL] menu, then power-cycle the drive.
RS-485 trunk: shielded twisted pair plus a common conductor; each line terminator is 120 ohm in series with 1 nF; the master supplies bus polarization.
Write CMD and the reference at least once so the Modbus channel becomes active and monitored.
gotchas: Factory Add = OFF: a brand-new drive is silent on the bus.
Configuration parameters (R/WS) are refused while the motor is running.
CMI bit 1 (save to EEPROM) clears itself, but if CMI is written cyclically the master must write it back to 0; EEPROM life is about 100,000 writes.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
